title: Edge of Eternities Promos: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: As the supervoid's photon collar washed over them, time stopped. Their souls would experience the grandeur of their demise for eternity.
Cosmogrands of the Celestial Palatinate always seek to expand their grip on the Edge.
"I have forgotten sleep in their prison." —Korelaa, prison escapee
Born of dead stars, the Astelli may fight for light, but they know the void as their womb.
Emissary mechans are often assigned their own security detail given their importance in inter-Pinnacle dialogs.
"All is the hand that weaves the Fabric of Being. The Fabric of Being is All." —*Drix Codex*, line 1
"All things end. I'd rather embrace that truth than the fantasy of eternal light."
"Lightsick fools. All suns eventually set."
"They will call you a monster, but I call you worthy."
"Beyond the supervoid, existence collapses into a singular point. We are all dead. We all live." —Xu-Ifit, osteoharmonist
"Adapt to this, you bug-eyed planet-squatters!" —Admiral Scargruf, Kavaron Memorial Navy
Kavaron cannot be saved, but its culture can.
The agony that consumed him also gave him clarity of purpose.
It scrounges Kavaron's wasteland, unaware that its home can no longer support its purpose.
"We're a few bones short of a skeleton crew, Sami, but we've got plenty of spine."
A victory was the best retirement gift the admiral could have asked for.
"Soon we'll have enough firepower to rid Evendo of its bug infestation." —General Tekvu, Kavaron Memorial Navy
Not all species on Evendo welcomed the thawing of the ice.
"Come! Join me in the sun!"
"I've found a strange vine in the ice. Thawing for further analysis." —Meltstrider log, final entry
For Eumidians, terraforming and evolution are one and the same. They grow as their planet grows, in lockstep coexistence.
"Modify these alleles and try again."
>Alert: COSMOGOYF >Recommended Action: RUN —PSS *Erix* shipboard computer, final transmission
"We can all be more than we are. Let me help."
Kavaron's degradation poisoned many hearts, which the Monoists were happy to exploit.
"The hard way it is."
"Rejoice! For within sekhar, the final sacrifice, you will find passage to the Next Eternity." —Calnan, Monoist assassin
The howling winds could hardly be heard over the maddening thoughts of the godcore.
The future is set. The present remains uncertain.
"I'll never escape this rock, but I fear they will." —Decrypted log 4.11
"Log 1.4.778: Granove, a tropical moon teeming with endemic biota. A must see for any aspiring astrobiologist!" —*Maisie's Edge Chronicles*
"Log 1.7.618: Starshadow, a relic of a culture lost to calamity. Its people were eradicated in a single day—but by what?" —*Maisie's Edge Chronicles*
"Log 2.2.119: Kiln, known for its blazing forges and ancient lava seeps. The footing may be treacherous, but the metallurgy is grand!" —*Maisie's Edge Chronicles*
The heat of a sun condensed into a forge.
"Log 2.5.325: A newborn moon, Aqqat still churns with the fires of creation. I'm eager to see what it will become!" —*Maisie's Edge Chronicles*
"Log 2.9.089: Lammuat, the cemetery moon of salvage and secrets. Could be profitable for those brave enough to plumb its recesses." —*Maisie's Edge Chronicles*
